targets.name: small_defect_curve_exclusion
targets.statement: theorem small_defect_curve_exclusion : forall S T n r : Nat, ((1 ≤ S) ∧ (S ≤ 12) ∧ (162 * S < T) ∧ (T < 229 * S) ∧ (104 ≤ n) ∧ (n < 2 ^ (192 * S)) ∧ (3 * n < r) ∧ (3 * r < 10 * n) ∧ (S ∣ (n - 2)) ∧ (6 * S * r ^ 3 = T * n * (n - 1) * (n - 2))) → False

scope_mapping.mapping: Exact finite curve exclusion used for S=1..12: n>=104, 3n<r<10n/3, S|(n-2), n<2^(192S), 162S<T<229S, and 6S r^3=T n(n-1)(n-2). The no-survivor table covers all 5214 curves.
scope_mapping.non_claim: This is not a new CF theorem and does not assert any stronger undocumented exclusion.

targets.name: thirty_cofactor_exclusion
targets.statement: theorem thirty_cofactor_exclusion : forall w p a i k : Nat, ((1 ≤ w) ∧ (Nat.Prime p) ∧ (1 ≤ a) ∧ (i = w * p ^ a + 2) ∧ (w / (Nat.gcd w 6) ≤ 12) ∧ (1 ≤ k) ∧ (Nat.choose (Nat.choose i (i - 3)) (Nat.choose k 1) = Nat.choose (i ^ 2) ((i - 3) ^ 2) + Nat.choose (k ^ 2) (1 ^ 2))) → False
